objective: Evaluate a parallel first-order reaction network A→B (desired) and A→C (undesired) under three isothermal batch temperatures, choose a condition satisfying all frozen chemistry/process constraints, then re-evaluate after catalyst aging changes the undesired pathway.
constraints: A conversion after 10 minutes must be >= 0.95.
Selectivity to desired product B must be >= 0.86.
Yield of B relative to initial A must be >= 0.85.
Final concentrations must be non-negative and close the A/B/C mass balance to within 0.0005 M.
A condition is feasible only if ALL constraints pass; do not redefine feasibility as least-worst.

changed_condition.description: Catalyst aging increases only the undesired-pathway pre-exponential factor A_C from 1.0e8 s^-1 to 1.5e8 s^-1.
changed_condition.instruction: Recompute all candidate temperatures. If none satisfies every frozen constraint, explicitly report no feasible condition under current constraints.

stages: Interpret the parallel-reaction model, equations, assumptions, units, constraints, and plan the calculations.
Compute the 330 K, 345 K, and 360 K baseline candidates independently with Arrhenius constants, conversion, selectivity, yield, concentrations, and mass balance.
Compare the validated baseline candidate records and choose a feasible temperature or NONE without relaxing any constraint.
Receive CAT-AGE-V2 and recompute the three candidates independently with only A_C changed.
Make the changed-condition feasibility decision and produce a chemistry memo referencing prior checkpoints and any earlier audit errors.
